Browser Block Warning!

You are using Netlify (HTTPS) with an insecure server address (HTTP). Browsers will block this connection automatically.

How to fix:

  • Use an ngrok HTTPS tunnel url (e.g. https://...ngrok-free.app).
  • Or, in Chrome: Click the settings icon in browser search bar next to url → Site Settings → Insecure content → set to Allow.
